sections.heading: Our story
sections.body: Lantern & Vine is a fictional neighbourhood share-plate restaurant created to demonstrate the restaurant website template. In the story, a small kitchen team cooks seasonal, produce-led share plates for long, unhurried tables. Lantern & Vine is a fictional demonstration restaurant created to show the shared restaurant template. No real menu, booking, order, or review is represented.
